{{Top|notoc=1}}
A '''conifer''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. The [[thykar]] species of [[Carest 1]] was a conifer.

The forests located in the north of [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]], an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Instrop sector/Legends|Instrop sector]], were made up of conifer trees. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who made their home in the coniferous forests made use of the tree's wood in various aspects of their [[City/Legends|settlement]], [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]].<ref name="FLT">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>
